notes: Symptom: the module's autouse fixture makes bts.picks.get_game_statuses_detailed raise. At the parent (1eb29c5), _lock_decision_from_predictions catches that and falls back to the abstract bts.picks.get_game_statuses (patched {100: 'P'}). The only row is the confirmed 'Test' pick, so should_lock returns True and `assert result["should_post"] is False` fails (line 461 at abbfdc5, unique). The earlier assertions (skipped, new_lineups == 2, pick_name == 'Test') pass at the parent, which reaches the same cached pick through run_and_pick's coarse select_pick path (its detailed prefetch also raises and falls back to None). Static checks: run_single_check and _lock_decision_from_predictions(predictions, daily, date, early_lock_gap) keep their signatures at the parent; the src changes between 0799bf2 and 1eb29c5 (3e4f615, 26014bf, 3710227) touch provenance, experiment artifacts and backtest code, not these paths. Undeclared node: test_lock_decision_fails_closed_when_detailed_status_unavailable also fails at the parent, but its first assertion, `assert should_post is False`, passes there: the fixture pick is 0.72 against the coarse-included 0.81 projected contender, so the parent's gap rule also says False. It fails only at `assert best_projected is None` (line 553), because the parent returns the coarse-derived 0.81. It is selected for its green run and the runner will classify it, but it is not declared, since what fails there is not the fail-closed should_post contract. Not selected: the orchestrator and select_pick strict-mode tests (require_detailed_statuses= and bts.strategy.get_game_statuses_detailed are added by this fix).
